messages:
nina: Heads up — noticed sampleapp duplicate page requests during onboarding tests. It looks like the paginator retries the same cursor when a token refresh happens mid-flight and that exhausts our rate budget, causing a cascade of 429s.

al: Yikes. Which sdk/sampleapp flow? node or py? quick repro?

nina: node-sdk sampleapp, default quickstart flags. Steps:
1) ./start-quickstart --concurrency=8 --pages=10
2) run a script that forces token rotate every ~3s
3) stream through cursor pages faster than token TTL

nina: logs show interleaved events:
```
[2026-03-22T09:12:01Z] INFO paginator: fetch page cursor=42 attempt=1
[2026-03-22T09:12:02Z] WARN auth: refreshing token for acct=team-alpha
[2026-03-22T09:12:02Z] ERROR http: 401 -> trigger refresh/retry
[2026-03-22T09:12:02Z] INFO retry: re-enqueue cursor=42 attempt=2
[2026-03-22T09:12:03Z] INFO paginator: fetch page cursor=42 attempt=2
[2026-03-22T09:12:03Z] ERROR http: 429 rate_limit
```

al: So the same cursor gets fetched twice concurrently? That shouldn't happen. Node SDK uses an async iterator which can issue the next page concurrently if consumer doesn't await?

tj: Small parity note: go-sdk uses a in-flight map to mark cursor as fetching and dedupe retries. node-sdk historically allowed multiple inflight attempts for the same cursor when a retry is triggered by auth middleware. That explains duplicate traffic under refresh storms.

ben: Repro'd locally. If you hammer token rotate, we see one cursor get requested 3x before backoff kicks in. That will absolutely melt a small rate window.

nina: Temporary workaround for quickstart — set sampleapp env var SDK_MAX_CONCURRENCY=4 and ENABLE_RETRY_DEDUPE=true. That buys time for new users.

al: Long-term fix? We should unify behavior: add per-cursor in-flight dedupe and make auth middleware await outstanding fetches or attach the existing promise to the retry.

tj: Agreed. Proposed changes:
- node-sdk: add inflightCursorMap[cursor] -> promise, on retry return that promise instead of spawning new request
- auth middleware: on 401, refresh token but do not clear inflight map; attach refreshed token to existing inflight promises
- sampleapp: enable retry_dedupe by default in quickstart config and document race condition in onboarding guide

ben: Also add an idempotency hint header for page endpoints so servers can cheaply dedupe if clients misbehave: `X-Client-Page-ID: <cursor>` (optional).

al: Can we add a small integration test in devex CI that simulates token rotation while paginating? deterministic so we catch regressions.

tj: Yes — I'll add a harness that forces token expiry mock, runs the iterator under load, and asserts no duplicate fetches for the same cursor id.

ci-bot: Created issue #4201: "node-sdk: paginator duplicate requests during token refresh" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/issues/4201)

ci-bot: Opened PR #803: "add inflight cursor dedupe + quickstart default" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/803)

nina: Verified PR branch locally: duplicates gone, quicker onboarding experience. Will update quickstart docs to mention `ENABLE_RETRY_DEDUPE` and link to #4201.

ben: One more doc ask — add a short note in SDK parity page listing the default retry/dedupe semantics per SDK (node, py, go) so customers understand differences.

al: Good call. I'll follow up with a small table + recommended flags for sample apps.

nina: Thanks everyone. Closing thread — followups will be tracked in GH. :thumbsup:
